1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

widgets_values: A stylish young woman with soft, voluminous dark hair styled in a loose updo, wearing a form-fitting black satin gown adorned with intricate floral beadwork in red, blue, and gold. Scene: A minimalist studio space with neutral grey walls, soft volumetric haze, and cinematic lighting — warm key light from the left, cool rim light from behind, creating a velvety matte skin texture with no oily sheen. Motion: The woman begins in a poised, slightly angled stance matching Image 1 — facing 30° left, hands resting lightly on hips, gaze lowered (0s). She lifts her head gently, eyes opening with warmth and invitation. Her lips part into a genuine, radiant smile — cheeks rising softly, eyes crinkling at the corners. At 1.2s, she locks gaze with the camera and speaks clearly: “Welcome to my world.” Her voice is warm and perfectly synced with lip movement. Immediately after (1.5s), she transitions into a graceful Samba — hips swaying rhythmically in a 4-beat pattern, feet stepping lightly with toes forward, heels lifting subtly. Her right arm rises in fluid arcs with each hip sway, fingers relaxed; left hand stays lightly on hip. The satin gown flows with dynamic undulations, beading catching shifting highlights. From 1.5s to 6.5s, she dances with controlled energy — hair swaying, skirt flaring gently, posture upright yet relaxed. At 6.5s, she begins to slow: hips settle, arms drift down. By 7.8s, she returns to a pose nearly identical to the start — turned 30° left, hands on hips, gaze lowered — but with the skirt’s hem flowing in the opposite direction and hair drifting the other way, creating a seamless visual loop. Camera Movement: Starts with a slight Dutch tilt, orbits clockwise into a medium close-up during her smile (0–1.5s). Pulls back smoothly while rotating to full-body view as she dances (1.5–6.5s). At 6.5s, tilts slightly upward to capture upper motion, then lowers into a stabilized low-angle hero shot by 8s, emphasizing elegance and flow.

# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).
